fields.description: Sama Yas is Aldar’s residential collection beside Yas Park on Yas Island. Apartments, garden homes and duplexes are arranged around park living, with a hospitality-led service offering and kitchens developed with input from Chef Izu Ani.

sources.label: Aldar: Sama Yas buildings 2 and 3 brochure and layouts

Aldar FY2025 results: UAE pipeline, page 27

reviewCoverage.identity: Own developer project, January 2024 launch and buildings 2/3 brochure reviewed; release scope kept explicit.
reviewCoverage.location: Yas Park setting on Yas Island confirmed by Aldar.
reviewCoverage.residences: Official brochure distinguishes one-to-three-bedroom apartments, duplexes and maid-room variants. Launch also mentions penthouses without a recovered complete specification.
reviewCoverage.areas: Eight official plan plates visually inspected; no total-area schedule. Portal examples and one indexed official unit are identified rather than generalised.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own project and brochure checked; bespoke services are not assumed included in charges.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Portal launch minimums conflict, while the official indexed price is unit-specific. Current numeric project minimum left null.
reviewCoverage.payment: Two portals agree on 10/50/40. Indexed official unit shows 5/55/40; both total 60/40 but booking terms differ.
reviewCoverage.handover: FY2025 annual estimate, portal dates and indexed developer unit date conflict. No single quarter imposed on every release.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official current 53-page buildings 2/3 brochure downloaded; eight typical plans visually reviewed. Unit page direct fetch currently omits its indexed details.

overview: The original launch names Woods Bagot for architecture and Mustard & Linen for interiors. Chef Izu’s involvement extends to kitchen planning and the proposed dining experience. The current brochure presents both single-level homes and duplex arrangements, with varied balconies and maid-room configurations.
research.locationNote: The community adjoins Yas Park on Yas Island. Aldar’s launch describes connections to the island’s leisure destinations and highways serving wider Abu Dhabi and Dubai. Park-facing views and direct access depend on the chosen home.
research.priceNote: Property Finder lists a AED 1.9m launch figure; Bayut lists AED 2.1m. The indexed Aldar B1-G-01 listing quotes AED 6,760,764 for a specific three-bedroom home. These are different bases and do not establish a current project minimum.
research.paymentNote: The portal schedule below is 10% booking, 50% during construction and 40% at handover. Aldar’s indexed B1-G-01 example instead shows 5/55/40. Obtain the applicable unit schedule before reserving.
research.handoverNote: FY2025 pipeline: 2027. Property Finder reports Q3 2027; Bayut reports Q3 2028. Aldar’s indexed B1-G-01 listing shows Q1 2028. Timing requires release-specific written confirmation.

facts.label: Original release
facts.value: The January 2024 announcement described 234 homes across three low-rise buildings, with sales opening on 2 February 2024. This historical scope is not current available stock.

facts.label: Services and charges
facts.value: The brochure describes concierge, room service, a house car and catered park picnics. Confirm booking conditions, operating arrangements and extra charges before treating services as included benefits.
